These function calls post a message to the blackboards with the tentative machine->source choices for the current planning phase. The message is the same for both blackboards, as the goal is to minimize main-grid usage by assigning machines to shared renewable sources across 24 hours. 

In this case, the Irrigation pump (machine_014) and Irrigation pump (machine_017) are assigned to src_Geothermal, the CNC mill (machine_015) is assigned to src_Wind, and the Lighting bank (machine_016) is assigned to src_Solar. These assignments are based on the available shared sources and their hourly capacities, as well as the uniform loads of the machines. 

Please note that these are just tentative choices and may need to be adjusted based on the responses from other agents on the blackboards.
These messages will inform other agents about the tentative machine->source choices for Cascade Labs, allowing them to plan their own assignments accordingly and minimize overflow from the main grid.
These messages inform other sites about Aurora Industries' tentative machine->source choices during the planning phase, allowing for coordination and discussion to minimize main-grid usage.

These function calls will post a message to both Blackboard 0 and Blackboard 1, communicating the tentative machine->source choices for Beacon Works. This will facilitate discussion and coordination with other sites participating in the Smart Grid coordination task.

These function calls will post the message "Tentative machine->source choices: Irrigation pump (machine_014) to src_Geothermal, CNC mill (machine_015) to src_Wind, Lighting bank (machine_016) to src_Solar, Irrigation pump (machine_017) to src_Geothermal" to blackboards 2 and 3, which are private communication channels with other sites. This allows Delta Homes to share its tentative machine->source choices with other sites and coordinate assignments to minimize main-grid usage.

These function calls post a message to the blackboards indicating the tentative machine->source choices for the machines under Cascade Labs' control. The message is posted to both blackboard 1 and blackboard 2, which are private communication channels with other sites (Beacon Works and Delta Homes). This allows for coordination and discussion of source assignments to minimize main-grid usage.

These function calls will post the message "Tentative machine->source choices: Water heater (machine_001) to src_Solar, EV charger (machine_002) to src_Wind, Kiln (machine_003) to src_Biomass" to blackboard 0 and blackboard 3, respectively. This allows Aurora Industries to communicate its tentative machine->source choices to other participants on both blackboards.
